name: Action Watersports at Lakeside Marina
note: South Lake Tahoe marina counter — the archetypal Tahoe water operator and the shape the category was missing (the only prior water extraction was an atypical multi-day delivered luxury fleet). Everything is priced HOURLY. Launch is directly at the marina, so this is take-away rental, not a delivered fleet. All rentals include instruction and a life vest. Parasailing, public cruises, the Windsong sailing yacht tour, and the water taxi are guided/captained products and are deliberately NOT extracted (00_general §5 take-away rule). NOTE: rates genuinely differ by location here — Round Hill Pines is $5/hr cheaper across the board and does not carry the SUP bike or e-scooter — unlike CV Sports, whose four counters were byte-identical. The site states each location is independently owned and operated.

items.name: Single Kayak
items.description: Published as "Starting at $35/hr" at Lakeside Marina. Launches directly from the marina.

items.name: Double Kayak
items.description: Tandem kayak, "Starting at $45/hr" at Lakeside Marina.

items.name: 4-Person Pedal Boat
items.description: Human-powered pedal boat, "Starting at $60/hr" at Lakeside Marina.

items.name: SUP Surf Bike
items.description: Pedal-driven bike mounted on a stand-up paddleboard hull, "Starting at $55/hr". Offered at Lakeside and Timber Cove but NOT at Round Hill Pines.

items.name: SUP Electric Surf Scooter
items.description: Motorised stand-up board, "Starting at $65/hr" — the priciest paddle-craft in the fleet. Offered at Lakeside and Timber Cove but NOT at Round Hill Pines.

name: Action Watersports at Timber Cove Marina
note: ACTION: confirm whether this location is permanently closed, and if so merge it into the Lakeside Marina row rather than leaving a live operator page for an address that cannot be rented from. The site carries a persistent site-wide banner — "We are no longer operating out of Timber Cove. Please see our Lakeside Marina location for rentals." — yet the same pages still publish a complete Timber Cove rate card (single kayak $35/hr, double $45, SUP $40, pedal boats $45/$60, SUP bike $55, SUP e-scooter $65) and a working phone number. Stale rate content behind a closure banner is a genuine trap: extracting it would create a full inventory for a counter that no longer exists. Parked rather than extracted, and NOT demoted — the operator itself is unquestionably a renter, just not at this address.
